description_en: Associates protection objects with mitigation policies
description_zh: 防护对象关联防护策略
kebab_example: aliyun ddosbgp attach-to-policy --policy-id cd8b4d70-e4e0-413a-b390-e71d00000000 --ip-port-protocol-list PortRange=80-90 Ip=112.124.241.000 Port=80 Protocol=tcp --api-version 2018-07-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AttachToPolicy

fields.help_en:
The IP address of the protection object.
Prerequisite: The IP address must be added to the Anti-DDoS Origin instance by calling the AddIp operation in advance, and you must call the DescribeInstanceList operation to verify that the IP address has been added to the Anti-DDoS Origin instance
fields.help_zh:
防护对象的IP地址。
前置条件：该 IP 必须提前引用 AddIp API 添加到原生防护实例中并引用 DescribeInstanceList API 检查 IP 已经加入原生防护实例中
fields.name: ip

fields.help_en:
The port number of the protection object.
Only port-specific mitigation policies support this parameter
fields.help_zh:
防护对象的端口号。
仅端口防护策略支持
fields.name: port

fields.help_en:
The port range of the protection object.
Only port-specific mitigation policies support this parameter
fields.help_zh:
防护对象的端口范围。
仅端口防护策略支持
fields.name: port_range

fields.help_en:
The protocol type of the protection object. Valid values:

tcp: Transmission Control Protocol.
udp: User Datagram Protocol.
Only port-specific mitigation policies support this parameter
fields.help_zh:
防护对象的协议类型，取值：

tcp：表示传输控制协议。
udp：表示用户数据报协议。
仅端口防护策略支持
fields.name: protocol

parameters.help_en:
The version of the port-specific mitigation policy. Valid values:

Not specified: Associates the default surf mitigation engine policy.
2: Associates the new stream mitigation engine policy.
Only port-specific mitigation policies support this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
端口防护策略版本，取值：

不填：绑定默认 surf 防护引擎策略。
2：绑定新版 stream 防护引擎策略。
仅端口防护策略支持
parameters.name: port_version

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique identifier for each request, which can be used for troubleshooting and diagnostics
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
